summary.intent: Finish executing and shipping GSD Phase 70.1 (rotation read-plane durability and crash-resume soundness) — get the desktop-e2e D-16 acceptance gate green across macOS/Linux/Windows, then run the full ship-phase pipeline (verify/secure/validate/simplify/e2e/CodeRabbit/PR/resolve-reviews) to merge-ready state.
summary.outcome: Phase 70.1 shipped as PR #598 with all CI checks green on all three platforms and 0 unresolved review threads; along the way, two genuine security/soundness bugs were found and fixed (a revocation-bypass from a stale in-memory key refresh, and a TS-vs-Rust checkpoint-GC ordering divergence that could permanently lose read access on crash), three pre-existing platform CI gates were fixed, and follow-up todos (deep-path key-refresh gap, macOS FUSE-T Test 5/7 invalidation) were captured and the phase's own todos retired.

repo: This repo's CI does not run `cargo fmt --check` at all — running `cargo fmt -p <crate>` locally before committing is pure churn/version-skew risk and should be skipped unless a lint actually requires it.
`cargo fmt -p <crate>` still reformats every file in that crate (not just touched ones); always diff and revert out-of-scope files before committing.
The SC#6 grep gate requires a `// sc6-allow:` marker within a strict ±1-line window of a sanctioned raw IPNS resolve call — placing it 3 lines away fails the gate.
Windows winfsp builds require fuse-only test modules to be gated `#[cfg(all(test, feature = "fuse"))]`, not bare `#[cfg(test)]`, or they E0433 under `--features winfsp`.
Permission-based test induction (chmod-based write-failure simulation) doesn't work on Windows; such tests must be `#[cfg(unix)]`-gated.
The gsd commit helper can report `commit_failed` as a false negative even when the commit landed — always verify via `git log`, never blind-retry.

rust-analyzer diagnostics (E0063, dead_code, unresolved imports) are frequently stale mid-edit snapshots during active subagent edits — verify authoritatively with `cargo check`/`cargo test` before trusting them.
`gh pr edit` fails on this repo due to Projects-classic GraphQL incompatibility; patch PR bodies via `gh api -X PATCH repos/.../pulls/<N> -F body=@file`.
macOS FUSE-T defers file `release()` by ~40s and the local publish queue is edge-triggered with no wall-clock backstop — an idle mount can silently stall a queued republish indefinitely.
First-ever PR CI on a long-lived no-PR branch surfaces branch-wide gate failures (grep gates, platform-specific cargo jobs) that never ran during local development — open PRs earlier.

code.finding: rotate_read_on_scope_exit discarded RotateReadResult and never refreshed the grant-root inode's in-memory read key, so a subsequent local relink resealed under the stale old key — a revocation bypass. Fixed by threading &mut fs and calling refresh_grant_root_read_key.

build_scope_exit_child_override failed OPEN per-child (missing child or build_child_refs error → silently skipped), and the override REPLACES the grant-root's published child list — a transient sibling lookup failure would silently orphan that child. Fixed to propagate errors and fail closed, mirroring build_folder_metadata's discipline.

repairDirtyNode GC'd a child's ECIES key checkpoint immediately, even when the parent's batched republish hadn't happened yet (pendingChildCount>1) — a crash in that window permanently loses recoverability of that subtree. The Rust twin (engine.rs) already deferred GC via pending_checkpoint_node_ids; ported the same deferral pattern to TS.

Resume Skipped-branch only kept `.frontier` from verify_subtree_clean, discarding is_dirty, so a missing root (is_dirty:true, empty frontier) could be mis-marked Complete instead of routed to the fail-closed resolve. Same defect existed in the TS twin; fixed both to check `frontier.is_empty() && !is_dirty`.

A phase-added test induced write failure via Unix chmod 0o500 but ran its fail-closed assertion unconditionally, breaking on Windows where the chmod has no effect. Fixed by gating the whole test fn with #[cfg(unix)].

workflow: Twin-engine parity is not automatic — every substantive rotation-engine fix (missing-root dirty signal, checkpoint-GC ordering) had to be independently re-verified and ported to the other language's engine.

Adversarially verifying CodeRabbit/Greptile findings against actual code before fixing avoided two false fixes (client key-borrow zeroization claim, get_wrapped_key double-Zeroizing) while correctly escalating two real bugs.
Batching multiple independent fixes into one push before re-dispatching expensive CI (desktop-e2e, cross-platform cargo) avoids burning CI cycles.
The ship-phase flow does not run todo retirement automatically — pending todos with `resolves_phase` matching the shipped phase must be manually checked and moved to completed/.

friction: Windows CI hit a transient STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED (0xC0000142) API-startup flake unrelated to the code, requiring a re-run.

11GB of RAM was consumed by two rust-analyzer processes — one was an orphan bound to a deleted worktree directory (cipher-box-phase69), parented by a dangling leftover Claude Code session that also had to be killed.
Repeated stale rust-analyzer diagnostics (E0063, dead_code, unused import) required authoritative `cargo check`/`cargo test` re-verification multiple times, adding overhead.
Slow lint-staged/eslint pre-commit hooks on large files (engine.ts, ROADMAP.md) repeatedly hit the 120s Bash timeout mid-commit, requiring timeout increases and post-hoc git-log verification.
An unscoped `cargo fmt -p cipherbox-fuse` reformatted 8 out-of-scope files with a version-skew risk vs. what already passed CI, discovered only after diffing — had to be reverted.
CodeRabbit CLI review's first hypothesis (single shared root cause for +2 bump and revocation bypass) was partially wrong/inverted and had to be corrected by deeper agent investigation.
The initial macOS D-16 timeout was misdiagnosed at first as pure CI slowness before being root-caused as a genuine edge-triggered publish-queue starvation bug.
open_items: PR #598 is fully green and all review threads resolved but awaiting the user's explicit merge decision.

Deep scope-exit rotation only refreshes the grant-root inode's in-memory key, not intermediate parent inodes on a multi-level-deep delete — captured as a new todo (2026-07-09-deep-scope-exit-rotation-refreshes-only-grant-root-inode-key.md).

macOS FUSE-T ignores inval_inode, causing desktop-e2e cross-client-sync Test 5 (content sync) and Test 7 (folder rename sync) to remain soft-skipped on macOS — captured as a todo (2026-07-09-macos-fuse-t-cross-client-sync-invalidation.md).
ROT-04: desktop query_grants_rooted_at re-mint no-op remains a sanctioned deferral (pre-existing todo).
WinFsp handle_rename ungated-dest D-15d gate-ordering parity remains deferred (pre-existing todo, narrowed to rename-only after this phase closed the delete-path parity gap).
Consider memorializing the pattern of orphaned rust-analyzer/dangling Claude sessions surviving deleted worktrees as a cleanup-discipline note.
